versions.changelog:
- Documentation expanded and clarified in README.md.
- Additional usage examples, troubleshooting advice, and step-by-step setup instructions included.
- Security guidance and common workflow sections improved for easier reference.

Initial release of YouTube research & transcription skill.

- Search YouTube videos, channels, and playlists using the YouTube Data API v3.
- Retrieve video details (title, description, stats, publish date) and channel info.
- Fetch video transcripts via MCP server, with yt-dlp fallback when needed.
- Provides setup instructions for both MCP server and yt-dlp.
- Includes example usage workflows for video research, transcript extraction, and troubleshooting.
